scope.description: Whole calculix application/library breadth across useful functional families.
scope.denominator: Finite-element geometry/mesh input, materials, loads/constraints, linear/nonlinear structural analysis, thermal analysis and result evaluation.

coverage.rationale: The supported member product now spans six signed end resultants, axial/biaxial bending/torsion, superposition, two compatible restraints and meaningful native measured requirements. It remains one straight solid rectangular section/material/static family within a much larger general multiphysics FEA application; no broad application-completion claim follows from deeper checks.

scope.description: Rectangular isotropic linear-elastic members assessed from dimensions, material, six end resultants, compatible restraint and measured serviceability limits.
scope.denominator: User intent and domain decisions within the named supported workflows, including declared inputs, composition and useful outputs; excluded application features do not enter this score.

abstraction.rationale: Physical end-resultant and restraint intent drives consistent quadratic forces/couples, meshes, automatic refinement, independent axial/bending/torsional/equilibrium acceptance and measured translation/twist/interior sampled-stress decisions. Solver-deck construction and native processes are hidden within the bounded supported product; general structural assemblies and peak/failure decisions remain unsupported.

limitations: Only one solid rectangular geometry/section and isotropic linear material/static-analysis family; arbitrary meshes/decks, general constraints/assemblies, nonlinearity, contact, buckling, dynamics and thermal analysis remain unsupported.

Native proof is bounded to named cases and declared tolerances; continuous superpositions are not exhaustively qualified. Interior normal/von Mises measurements do not bound peak or certify yielding/fatigue.
Subjective whole-application and supported-workflow editorial scores; neither is a native API ratio, runtime availability or source-bound qualification claim.
